title: Republic Act No. 10963 - Tax Reform for Acceleration and Inclusion (TRAIN), as enacted
version_kind: enacted text (not consolidated); unofficial transcription by the Supreme Court E-Library
converter: conv.py (legalese commons, 2026-10-19): Supreme Court E-Library showdocs HTML -> UTF-8 text; the document body (div.single_content after the printer-friendly link) only; block elements (p, div, br, li) as line breaks, inline formatting dropped, whitespace collapsed, blank lines removed; tables rendered as '| cell | cell |' rows (merged header cells appear once); no words altered
why: Rewrites NIRC Section 24(A) (the graduated rates for individuals, with the schedule for 1 January 2023 onwards, the 8% option for self-employed individuals and professionals, mixed-income earners, and the minimum wage earner exemption) and Section 32(B)(7)(e) (exclusion of 13th month pay and other benefits up to P90,000), among many others.
editor_notes: EDITOR'S NOTE (legalese commons, 2026-10-19): in amended Section 24(A)(2)(a), the 2018-2022 schedule row 'Over P2,000,000 but not over P8,000,000' reads 'P130,000 + 32% of the excess over P2,000,000' in this E-Library transcription. The amount appears to be a transcription error: the schedule's own arithmetic gives P490,000 (P130,000 + 30% of P1,200,000). 'P402.500' and 'Over P8.000,000' in the 2023 schedule are the E-Library's punctuation. The text below is left exactly as the E-Library shows it; check against the signed copy in the Official Gazette before encoding these figures.
